title: REVOKE_SPONSORSHIP fails with REVOKE_SPONSORSHIP_LOW_RESERVE
pattern: A transaction whose REVOKE_SPONSORSHIP operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (low_reserve). Revoking the sponsorship of a data entry hands its 0.5 XLM reserve to the owner, who sits at its minimum balance.

hazards.placement: revoking a sponsorship the owner cannot take over

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
